core.title: Solid Brass 6 Inch Kickdown Door Holder, Field Enterprises 9921-US10B

text.description_html:
FEI-9921-US10B 6" Kickdown Door Holder

This kickdown door holder mounts to the lower surface of the door to keep it in an open position. You can flip it up in a locked position, and then flip it down when you want to have the door stay open.

These kickdown door stops are made of Solid Brass by Field Enterprises.

It includes a non-skid rubber tip to protect the floor, and is supplied with new mounting screws.

Specifications of FEI-9921-US10B Kickdown Door Holder

  • Total Length: 6"
  • Arm Length: 5.25"
  • Rubber Tip: Black
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Packaged with Mounting Screws
